fea-engineers-using-agentic-ai-practitio.body: Posted in last 7 days FEA Engineers Using Agentic AI - Practitioner Case Study 𝗛𝗮𝘃𝗲 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝘂𝘀𝗲𝗱 𝗮𝗴𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗶𝗰 𝗔𝗜 𝗶𝗻 𝘆𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝘀𝗶𝗺𝘂𝗹𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝘄𝗼𝗿𝗸? If so, I would like to hear from you. This fall, in collaboration with Synera, I will be hosting "𝗔𝗴𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗶𝗰 𝗔𝗜 𝗶𝗻 𝗦𝗶𝗺𝘂𝗹𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻", a two-part webinar series to help engineers and engineering managers understand what AI agents can do for FEA, how they improve simulation practice, and how to bring them into an organization. Part 1 (October 27) will cover "𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗙𝗼𝘂𝗻𝗱𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗙𝗶𝗿𝘀𝘁 𝗨𝘀𝗲 𝗖𝗮𝘀𝗲", Part 2 (November 12) will focus on "𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗣𝗿𝗮𝗰𝘁𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗲𝗿'𝘀 𝗣𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗽𝗲𝗰𝘁𝗶𝘃𝗲". For Part 2, I am looking for a guest who has applied agentic AI to real simulation work and is willing to share a candid account: what changed, what surprised you, and where you still had to step in as the engineer. If that sounds like you, please send me a direct message. And if you know someone who fits, please tag them in the comments. Full details on the series, including the content of each session, will be shared soon. Stay tuned. #FEA #Simulation #AgenticAI #CAE #FEAAcademy

parents-ai-acting-as-pseudoparent-in-kid.headline: Parents - AI Acting As Pseudo-Parent In Kid Questions
parents-ai-acting-as-pseudoparent-in-kid.body: Posted in last 7 days Parents - AI Acting As Pseudo-Parent In Kid Questions Is AI becoming a pseudo-parent to your children? Parents, has your kid ever asked ChatGPT something you wish they'd asked you? Did they turn to ChatGPT to learn about the bird and the bees, or some moral question you wish they came to you first with? Or maybe it's the opposite: you've noticed they don't come to you for homework help anymore, and it's been a weirdly mixed bag of relief and sadness. I'm looking for parents with a specific moment like that, big or small, where it might feel like AI is overstepping as a pseudo-parent. I'm a writer journalist working on a story and would love to chat about this!

employees-conflicted-about-ai-use-genera.headline: Employees Conflicted About AI Use - Generative AI Workplace Impact
employees-conflicted-about-ai-use-genera.body: Posted in last 7 days Employees Conflicted About AI Use - Generative AI Workplace Impact Looking to talk to people conflicted about AI use at work Hello everyone! I'm an artist and filmmaker based in Woodside working on a new video project about generative AI and changing workplace dynamics. I'm looking to talk to people who feel conflicted about their AI use at work. The adoption of generative AI in many workplaces has changed how we do and relate to our work, and to our coworkers. People I've spoken to so far have said the introduction of AI has led to greater mistrust of their coworkers, shame around their own use, and avoiding full disclosure when they use AI. Most people say there are no formal policies around AI use in their workplace. If this sounds familiar to you, I'd love to talk! If you’re interested, please fill out the form below or message me. Thank you! https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdWsFQ0q\_Mngmu7kGKnLwt4Z-Z4\_Exh5H41eqJ0rjk0t1i1Jg/viewform?usp=dialog
